verdict.rationale: Reflect clearly supports tags (#tags) for organization and retrieval, including automatic tagging (e.g. Kindle imports tagged #book) and filtering notes by #tags, backlinks, dates, and pinned status. However, there is no evidence of 'typed properties' (structured metadata fields with types, akin to database properties) — Reflect's organization model is built around tags, backlinks, and daily notes, not typed property schemas. Missing for 10: evidence of typed/structured properties (not just tags), evidence of consistent property schemas across notes, and any UI for defining property types.
